overrideProperties.Name: Crye Precision JPC Plate Carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
overrideProperties.Description: The widely beloved Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) was designed to maximize operator mobility by reducing weight and bulk. Its modular system allows for personalized loadouts and quick gear adjustments depending on the mission. Manufactured by Crye Precision. MultiCam version. (ISB SOF)

po.name: Colete Tático Crye Precision JPC (Agência de Suporte a Inteligência da USEC)
po.description: O popular Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) foi projetado para maximizar a mobilidade do operador, reduzindo o peso e o volume.
